name: Quarantine Notices
summary: The mayor must file the plague notices in triplicate with three seals before the inn may be closed.

stages.journal: Mayor Somerton wants three seals on the quarantine notices: his own, Tamsin Ledger's and the post office's.
stages.hint: Get Tamsin Ledger's countersign in the Mayor's House and the postmaster's stamp, then see the mayor.

stages.journal: The notices are filed, in triplicate.
